rationale: C11 is an earlier amendment to the same specifically numbered executive order and has the same distinctive title phrase, “amending executive order no 9805 prescribing regulations governing.” Its operative text revises the regulations and incorporates an attached rate schedule, making it a concrete, highly plausible template for the later amendment, whose surviving text likewise consists principally of an inserted table. C15 and C25 are weaker parallels involving amendments or detailed regulations with schedules, but they concern different regulatory schemes.
